merge_params_loaded_inited: merge loaded checkpoint parameters with initialized model parameters using merge_params
load_params_from_checkpoint: load model parameters from an npz or tensorstore checkpoint file with load_params
tree_get_by_path: get a nested pytree value by its flattened key path like a/b/c using tree_get
tsload_arrays_from_disk: load tensorstore-based array trees from disk with optional regex filtering via tsload
npload_numpy_file: load a numpy npz or npy file and return an ndarray or dict using npload
